column1: # The non-image pins `og dev renovate-check` counts (.github/workflows/renovate-dry-run.yml):
# each must be a dependency Renovate detects in every place it is pinned, as often as the text has it.
# dependency<TAB>file or glob (wildcards in the last part only)<TAB>regular expression for one pin,
# with ^ and $ at line ends. A missing file or a glob that matches nothing is an error.
# Only the files listed for a dependency are counted: python is also the docker image of
# versions.env, which the image checks cover.
# A setup-nextflow step is a pin when a version: line with a literal version follows its uses:
# line inside the same step (the lines in between are blank or start with anything but '-',
# which opens the next step); a computed version (an expression) is not a pin.
